name: Sorry Ma, Forgot to Take Out the Trash

podcast.body: This album represents The Replacements' early hardcore sound, capturing their initial style which was heavily influenced by punk rock pioneers. It marked their debut and showcased their roots before they evolved into a more melodic power pop band. "This is from their early days and their debut album, Sorry Ma, Forgot to Take Out the Trash."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
